A solemn woman in a crimson robe sits upright on a marble throne. In one hand she holds a long, gleaming sword; in the other, perfectly balanced brass scales. Her face is calm but immovable, her eyes covered with a golden blindfold.

Setting: A marble hall with a tall arch behind her, columns disappearing into shadow.  
Lighting: Symmetrical spotlight from above, casting perfect dual shadows on each side.  
Expression: Absolute neutrality. No anger, no mercy — only balance.

Atmosphere: Everything around her is still, heavy with silence. Dust floats like time itself has slowed.oo
